ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Portfolio outcome, Active and later stages need Amount invested, Ownership and Lead partner.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Active", 1, "Follow-on review", 2, "Exit preparation", 3, "Exit process", 4, "Exited", 5, 0) >= 1, OR(ISBLANK(Amount_invested__c), ISBLANK(Ownership_percent__c), ISBLANK(Lead_partner__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount invested, Ownership and Lead partner before moving to Active.
